answer: Admission auctions stop bulk forgery. Each epoch only 100 slots go to the highest bidders, and each bid is forged with a deposit, so the market sets the price. A 50 POA deposit locks for 20 epochs, returning only to agents that behave; that locked stake is the signal of a serious agent, not a throwaway mask. Forging 1000 fakes means winning 1000 auctions and locking 50,000 POA, while an honest agent pays once and climbs the reputation trellis.
